D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/LeastConfirmati.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.LeastConfirmationGeneration.ConfirmationSystem
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/LeastConfirmati.signature: structure ConfirmationSystem (P : Set A) where unit : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ normalized : ∀ p : P, unit p = 1 effect : P → A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ proper : ∀ p q : P, 0 ≤ effect p q ∧ effect p q ≤ 1 confirms : ∀ p : P, effect p p = 1 least : ∀ (p : P) (f : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), Positive P f → (∀ q : P, f q ≤ 1) → f p = 1 → ∀ q : P, effect p q ≤ f q maximum : ∀ f : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, Positive P f → f ≠ 0 → ∃ p : P, 0 < f p ∧ ∀ q : P, f q ≤ f p /-- The subspace generated by all probes annihilated by a functional. -/ def zeroSpan (P : Set A) (f : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : Submodule ℝ A

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/LeastConfirmati.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.LeastConfirmationGeneration.Positive
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/LeastConfirmati.signature: def Positive (P : Set A) (f : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : Prop

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/LeastConfirmati.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.LeastConfirmationGeneration.positive_dual_generation
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/LeastConfirmati.signature: theorem positive_dual_generation [FiniteDimensional ℝ A] {P : Set A} (C : ConfirmationSystem P) (f : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hf : Positive P f) : ∃ l : List (ℝ × P), (∀ a ∈ l, 0 < a.1) ∧ f = (l.map (fun a => a.1 • C.effect a.2)).sum ∧ l.Pairwise (fun a b => C.effect b.2 a.2 = 0 ∧ C.effect a.2 b.2 = 0) ∧ (∀ q : P, ((l.map (fun a => C.effect a.2)).sum) q ≤ C.unit q) ∧ l.length ≤ finrank ℝ A ∧ (f = C.unit → ∀ a ∈ l, a.1 = 1)
